text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "surplus renewable energy produced in the summer is stored for use in the winter by means of a thermochemical process", "gist": "Summer renewable energy surplus is stored for winter use via thermochemical process"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "sodium hydroxide solution", "gist": "chemical solution used in the process"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "using renewable energy or heat in summer by extracting water from it", "gist": "concentration occurs in summer using renewable energy or heat by removing water"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "stored separately at room temperature without any losses until winter", "gist": "sodium hydroxide and water stored separately at room temp until winter with no loss"}, {"type": "process", "quote": "diluted again by means of evaporation and absorption of water, heat is generated", "gist": "heat generated by diluting sodium hydroxide with evaporated water"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "can then be used for heating by the sorption storage heat pump with almost no additional electrical energy", "gist": "heat used for heating via sorption storage heat pump with minimal extra electricity"}]}
